original_english: Variations arising during the process of reproduction can be inherited.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction ke process ke dauran jo variations aate hain, woh inherit ho sakte hain.

original_english: The rules of heredity determine the process by which traits and characteristics are reliably inherited.
hinglish_roman: Heredity ke rules determine karte hain ki traits aur characteristics kis tarah reliably inherit hoti hain.

original_english: Mendel used pea plants with different characteristics such as tall and short plants to study inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne alag-alag characteristics wale pea plants use kiye jaise tall aur short plants, inheritance study karne ke liye.

original_english: In the F1 generation, all plants were tall and there were no halfway characteristics.
hinglish_roman: F1 generation mein saare plants tall the aur koi bhi halfway characteristics nahi thi.

original_english: In the F2 generation, one quarter of the plants were short, showing that the shortness trait was hidden in F1.
hinglish_roman: F2 generation mein ek chaurthai plants short the, jisse pata chala ki shortness trait F1 mein chhupa hua tha.

original_english: Mendel proposed that two copies of a factor, now called genes, control each trait in sexually reproducing organisms.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne propose kiya ki do copies ek factor ki, jo ab genes kehlaate hain, har trait ko control karti hain sexually reproducing organisms mein.

original_english: A trait like tallness that is expressed even with one copy is called a dominant trait.
hinglish_roman: Ek trait jaise tallness jo sirf ek copy se bhi express hoti hai, use dominant trait kehte hain.

original_english: A recessive trait is only expressed when both copies of the gene are recessive.
hinglish_roman: Recessive trait tab hi express hoti hai jab dono gene copies recessive hon.

original_english: Both TT and Tt represent tall plants, while only tt represents a short plant.
hinglish_roman: TT aur Tt dono tall plants ko represent karte hain, jabki sirf tt ek short plant ko represent karta hai.

original_english: When two traits are studied together, they are inherited independently of each other.
hinglish_roman: Jab do traits ko saath mein study kiya jaata hai, toh woh ek doosre se independently inherit hote hain.

original_english: In the dihybrid cross, F2 offspring showed a 9:3:3:1 ratio of different trait combinations.
hinglish_roman: Dihybrid cross mein, F2 offspring ne alag-alag trait combinations ka 9:3:3:1 ratio dikhaya.

original_english: Genes control characteristics by coding for proteins such as enzymes that regulate biological processes.
hinglish_roman: Genes characteristics ko control karte hain proteins ke liye code karke, jaise enzymes jo biological processes ko regulate karte hain.

original_english: Plant height depends on the amount of a particular plant hormone, which depends on the efficiency of the enzyme producing it.
hinglish_roman: Plant ki height ek khaas plant hormone ki quantity par depend karti hai, jo uss enzyme ki efficiency par depend karta hai jo use produce karta hai.

original_english: Both parents contribute equally to the DNA of the progeny during sexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein dono parents progeny ke DNA mein barabar contribution dete hain.

original_english: Each pea plant must have two sets of all genes, one inherited from each parent.
hinglish_roman: Har pea plant mein saare genes ke do sets hone chahiye, ek ek parent se inherit hua.

original_english: Each gene set is present as separate independent pieces called chromosomes, not as a single long thread of DNA.
hinglish_roman: Har gene set alag independent pieces ke roop mein hota hai jo chromosomes kehlaate hain, na ki ek lambi DNA thread ke roop mein.

original_english: Each cell has two copies of each chromosome, one each from the male and female parents.
hinglish_roman: Har cell mein har chromosome ki do copies hoti hain, ek male parent se aur ek female parent se.

original_english: Every germ cell will take one chromosome from each pair, which may be of either maternal or paternal origin.
hinglish_roman: Har germ cell har pair se ek chromosome leti hai, jo maternal ya paternal origin ki ho sakti hai.

original_english: When two germ cells combine, they restore the normal number of chromosomes in the progeny.
hinglish_roman: Jab do germ cells combine hoti hain, toh woh progeny mein chromosomes ki normal number restore kar deti hain.

original_english: Human beings have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein 22 pairs autosomes hote hain aur ek pair sex chromosomes ka hota hai.

original_english: Women have two X chromosomes, while men have one X and one Y chromosome.
hinglish_roman: Auraton mein do X chromosomes hote hain, jabki mardon mein ek X aur ek Y chromosome hota hai.

original_english: The sex of a child is determined by what chromosome they inherit from their father.
hinglish_roman: Bacche ka sex is baat par depend karta hai ki use apne baap se kaun sa chromosome mila.

original_english: A child who inherits an X chromosome from her father will be a girl.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacha apne baap se X chromosome inherit karta hai woh ladki hogi.

original_english: A child who inherits a Y chromosome from his father will be a boy.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacha apne baap se Y chromosome inherit karta hai woh ladka hoga.

original_english: All children will inherit an X chromosome from their mother regardless of whether they are boys or girls.
hinglish_roman: Saare bacche apni maa se ek X chromosome zaroor inherit karte hain chahe woh ladka ho ya ladki.

original_english: In some reptiles, the temperature at which fertilised eggs are kept determines whether animals will be male or female.
hinglish_roman: Kuch reptiles mein, jis temperature par fertilised eggs rakhe jaate hain, uss se tay hota hai ki janwar male hoga ya female.

original_english: In snails, individuals can change sex, indicating that sex is not genetically determined.
hinglish_roman: Snails mein, individuals apna sex badal sakte hain, jo batata hai ki sex genetically determined nahi hota.

original_english: Inheritance from the previous generation provides both a common basic body design and subtle changes for the next generation.
hinglish_roman: Pichhli generation se inheritance dono cheezein provide karti hai — ek common basic body design aur subtle changes jo agli generation ke liye hote hain.

original_english: If sexual reproduction is involved, even greater diversity will be generated across generations.
hinglish_roman: Agar sexual reproduction involved ho, toh generations mein aur bhi zyada diversity generate hogi.

original_english: Bacteria that can withstand heat will survive better in a heat wave, showing how environment selects variants.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacteria heat bardaasht kar sakte hain woh heat wave mein better survive karte hain, jisse pata chalta hai ki environment variants ko select karta hai.

original_english: Mendel was educated in a monastery and studied science and mathematics at the University of Vienna.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ki padhai ek monastery mein hui thi aur unhone University of Vienna mein science aur mathematics padha.

original_english: Mendel was the first to keep count of individuals exhibiting a particular trait in each generation.
hinglish_roman: Mendel pehle scientist the jinhone har generation mein ek particular trait dikhane wale individuals ko count kiya.

original_english: Tallness and round seeds are dominant traits in pea plants.
hinglish_roman: Tallness aur round seeds pea plants mein dominant traits hain.

original_english: New combinations of traits appear in F2 offspring when factors controlling seed shape and colour recombine.
hinglish_roman: F2 offspring mein nayi trait combinations tab aati hain jab seed shape aur colour control karne wale factors recombine karte hain.

original_english: A section of DNA that provides information for one protein is called the gene for that protein.
hinglish_roman: DNA ka woh section jo ek protein ke liye information provide karta hai, use uss protein ka gene kehte hain.

original_english: If an enzyme works efficiently, a lot of hormone will be made and the plant will be tall.
hinglish_roman: Agar enzyme efficiently kaam kare, toh zyada hormone banega aur plant tall hoga.

original_english: If the gene for an enzyme has an alteration, the enzyme becomes less efficient and less hormone is produced.
hinglish_roman: Agar kisi enzyme ke gene mein alteration ho jaaye, toh woh enzyme kam efficient ho jaata hai aur kam hormone produce hota hai.

original_english: The sex chromosome pair in men is a mismatched pair where one is a normal X while the other is a short Y.
hinglish_roman: Mardon mein sex chromosome pair ek mismatched pair hota hai jahan ek normal X hota hai aur doosra ek chota Y hota hai.

original_english: Human populations show a great deal of variation among different individuals.
hinglish_roman: Human populations mein alag-alag individuals ke beech kaafi variation dekha jaata hai.

original_english: Free and attached earlobes are two variants found in human populations.
hinglish_roman: Free aur attached earlobes human populations mein paaye jaane wale do variants hain.

original_english: Both the father and mother contribute practically equal amounts of genetic material to the child.
hinglish_roman: Baap aur maa dono practically barabar matra mein genetic material bacche ko dete hain.

original_english: For each trait there will be two versions in each child, one from each parent.
hinglish_roman: Har trait ke liye har bacche mein do versions hote hain, ek ek parent se.

original_english: Asexual reproduction produces very little variation because differences arise only from small inaccuracies in DNA copying.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction mein bahut kam variation hoti hai kyunki differences sirf DNA copying mein chhoti galtiyon se aate hain.

original_english: Selection of variants by environmental factors forms the basis for evolutionary processes.
hinglish_roman: Environmental factors dwara variants ka selection evolutionary processes ka aadhaar banta hai.

original_english: Sexually reproducing individuals have two copies of genes for the same trait.
hinglish_roman: Sexually reproducing individuals mein ek hi trait ke liye genes ki do copies hoti hain.

original_english: If the copies of a gene are not identical, the trait that gets expressed is called the dominant trait.
hinglish_roman: Agar gene ki copies identical nahi hain, toh jo trait express hoti hai use dominant trait kehte hain.

original_english: The other trait that is hidden when a dominant trait is present is called the recessive trait.
hinglish_roman: Jo doosri trait dominant trait ki maujoodgi mein chhup jaati hai use recessive trait kehte hain.

original_english: Traits in one individual may be inherited separately, giving rise to new combinations of traits in offspring.
hinglish_roman: Ek individual mein traits alag-alag inherit ho sakti hain, jisse offspring mein nayi combinations banti hain.

original_english: In human beings, the sex of the individual is largely genetically determined.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein, kisi individual ka sex zyaadatar genetically determine hota hai.

original_english: The genes inherited from our parents decide whether we will be boys or girls.
hinglish_roman: Hamare parents se inherit hone wale genes decide karte hain ki hum ladke honge ya ladkiyaan.

original_english: Mendel crossed a tall plant and a short plant and found that all F1 progeny were tall.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne ek tall plant aur ek short plant ko cross karaya aur paya ki saare F1 progeny tall the.

original_english: Self-pollination of F1 tall plants produces both tall and short plants in F2 generation.
hinglish_roman: F1 tall plants ke self-pollination se F2 generation mein tall aur short dono tarah ke plants bante hain.

original_english: A child resembles its parents but is not exactly the same due to genetic variations produced by meiosis.
hinglish_roman: Bacha apne parents se milta julta hai lekin meiosis se hone wali genetic variations ki wajah se bilkul wahi nahi hota.

original_english: In a sugarcane field, very little variation is seen among the individual plants.
hinglish_roman: Ganne ke khet mein alag-alag plants ke beech bahut kam variation dikhayi deti hai.

original_english: The two characteristics of round seeds and wrinkled seeds are controlled by separate gene pairs.
hinglish_roman: Round seeds aur wrinkled seeds ki do characteristics alag-alag gene pairs se control hoti hain.

original_english: Cellular DNA is the information source for making proteins in the cell.
hinglish_roman: Cellular DNA cell mein proteins banane ka information source hota hai.

original_english: Every germ cell must have only one gene set so that when two germ cells combine, the normal number is restored.
hinglish_roman: Har germ cell mein sirf ek gene set hona chahiye taaki jab do germ cells combine hon toh normal number restore ho sake.

original_english: The Mendelian mechanism of inheritance is used by all sexually reproducing organisms.
hinglish_roman: Mendelian inheritance ka mechanism saare sexually reproducing organisms use karte hain.

original_english: In a Mendelian experiment with two traits, the F1 progeny all had round seeds and were tall.
hinglish_roman: Do traits wale Mendelian experiment mein, saare F1 progeny ke seeds round the aur woh tall bhi the.

original_english: Mendel blended his knowledge of science and mathematics to arrive at the laws of inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne science aur mathematics ki apni knowledge ko milaakar inheritance ke laws tak pahunche.

original_english: Half the children will be boys and half will be girls based on sex chromosome inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Sex chromosome inheritance ke basis par aadhe bacche ladke honge aur aadhe ladkiyaan.

original_english: Variations promote survival by allowing some individuals to be better suited to changing environments.
hinglish_roman: Variations survival ko promote karte hain kyunki kuch individuals changing environments ke liye zyada suitable hote hain.

original_english: The law of segregation states that the two alleles for a trait separate during gamete formation.
hinglish_roman: Law of segregation kehta hai ki kisi trait ke do alleles gamete banane ke waqt alag ho jaate hain.

original_english: The law of independent assortment states that genes for different traits are inherited independently.
hinglish_roman: Law of independent assortment kehta hai ki alag-alag traits ke genes independently inherit hote hain.

original_english: If a trait A exists in 10 percent of a population it likely arose more recently than a trait existing in 60 percent.
hinglish_roman: Agar koi trait A, population ke 10 percent mein hai, toh woh probably uss trait se zyada recently aaya hai jo 60 percent mein hai.

original_english: Gametes are formed by meiosis, which ensures each gamete carries only half the chromosome number.
hinglish_roman: Gametes meiosis se bante hain, jisse ensure hota hai ki har gamete mein sirf aadhi chromosome number ho.

original_english: A test cross is performed to verify the genotype of a plant showing the dominant phenotype.
hinglish_roman: Test cross tab kiya jaata hai jab dominant phenotype dikhane wale plant ka genotype verify karna hota hai.

original_english: Phenotype refers to the physical expression of a trait, while genotype refers to the genetic makeup.
hinglish_roman: Phenotype trait ki physical expression hoti hai, jabki genotype genetic makeup ko refer karta hai.

original_english: Homozygous organisms have two identical copies of a gene, while heterozygous organisms have two different copies.
hinglish_roman: Homozygous organisms mein gene ki do identical copies hoti hain, jabki heterozygous organisms mein do alag copies hoti hain.

original_english: The stability of the DNA of a species is maintained through the mechanism of sexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Kisi species ke DNA ki stability sexual reproduction ke mechanism ke zariye maintain hoti hai.

original_english: In a monohybrid cross, a 3:1 ratio is observed in the F2 generation.
hinglish_roman: Monohybrid cross mein, F2 generation mein 3:1 ratio dekha jaata hai.

original_english: The 1:2:1 ratio in F2 represents TT, Tt, and tt genotype combinations.
hinglish_roman: F2 mein 1:2:1 ratio TT, Tt aur tt genotype combinations ko represent karta hai.

original_english: The second generation progeny of F1 tall plants are not all tall — one quarter of them are short.
hinglish_roman: F1 tall plants ke second generation progeny saare tall nahi hote — unka ek chaurthai hissa short hota hai.

original_english: Genetic diversity generated through sexual reproduction increases the chances of species survival.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction se hone wali genetic diversity species ke survival ke chances badhati hai.

original_english: The earlobe study in class helps students observe how traits like free or attached earlobes are inherited.
hinglish_roman: Class mein earlobe study se students observe karte hain ki free ya attached earlobes jaise traits kaise inherit hote hain.

original_english: Mendel chose pea plants for experiments because they have many observable traits and a short life cycle.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne pea plants choose kiye experiments ke liye kyunki unme kai observable traits hain aur life cycle choti hoti hai.

original_english: Mendel found that in F1 generation, all plants were tall when crossed with a short plant.
hinglish_roman: Jab Mendel ne tall aur short plants cross kiye toh F1 generation ke saare plants tall the.

original_english: The trait that appeared in F1 generation was called the dominant trait.
hinglish_roman: Jo trait F1 generation mein dikhta hai use dominant trait kehte hain.

original_english: The trait that disappeared in F1 but reappeared in F2 was called the recessive trait.
hinglish_roman: Jo trait F1 mein gayab ho jaata hai lekin F2 mein wapas aata hai use recessive trait kehte hain.

original_english: In F2 generation, Mendel observed a 3:1 ratio of tall to short plants.
hinglish_roman: F2 generation mein Mendel ne tall aur short plants ka 3:1 ratio dekha.

original_english: A monohybrid cross studies the inheritance of only one trait at a time.
hinglish_roman: Monohybrid cross mein sirf ek trait ki inheritance study ki jaati hai.

original_english: A dihybrid cross studies the inheritance of two different traits simultaneously.
hinglish_roman: Dihybrid cross mein do alag traits ki inheritance ek saath study ki jaati hai.

original_english: In a dihybrid cross F2, Mendel found a 9:3:3:1 ratio among offspring. This showed that traits assort independently.
hinglish_roman: Dihybrid cross ke F2 mein Mendel ne 9:3:3:1 ratio paya. Isse pata chala ki traits independently assort hote hain.

original_english: Mendel experimented with seven different traits in pea plants including seed colour and plant height.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne pea plants mein 7 alag traits par experiments kiye jisme seed colour aur plant height shamil the.

original_english: Tall plants with round seeds crossed with short wrinkled-seed plants gave F1 offspring that were all tall with round seeds.
hinglish_roman: Tall round-seed plants aur short wrinkled-seed plants ke cross se saare F1 offspring tall aur round-seed wale the. Yeh dono dominant traits the.

original_english: What is the difference between a monohybrid and a dihybrid cross?
hinglish_roman: Monohybrid cross aur dihybrid cross mein kya difference hai?

original_english: Why are all plants tall in F1 generation when a tall plant is crossed with a short plant?
hinglish_roman: Jab tall aur short plant cross hote hain toh F1 ke saare plants tall kyun hote hain?

original_english: What does the 3:1 ratio in F2 tell us about inheritance?
hinglish_roman: F2 mein 3:1 ratio inheritance ke baare mein kya bata ta hai?

original_english: Why did Mendel choose pea plants for his experiments?
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne apne experiments ke liye pea plants hi kyun choose kiye?

original_english: What is a dominant trait? Give an example from Mendel's experiment.
hinglish_roman: Dominant trait kya hota hai? Mendel ke experiment se ek example do.

original_english: According to the Law of Segregation, the two alleles of a gene separate during gamete formation.
hinglish_roman: Law of Segregation ke according, ek gene ke dono alleles gamete banate waqt alag ho jaate hain.

original_english: Each gamete carries only one allele for each gene.
hinglish_roman: Har gamete mein har gene ke liye sirf ek allele hota hai.

original_english: The Law of Independent Assortment states that different traits are inherited independently of each other.
hinglish_roman: Law of Independent Assortment kehta hai ki alag alag traits ek doosre se independently inherit hote hain.

original_english: Independent assortment works because genes for different traits are on separate chromosomes. This produces new combinations of traits.
hinglish_roman: Independent assortment isliye kaam karta hai kyunki alag traits ke genes alag chromosomes par hote hain. Isse naye trait combinations bante hain.

original_english: What is the Law of Segregation?
hinglish_roman: Law of Segregation kya hai aur yeh gametes mein kaise apply hota hai?

original_english: Why does independent assortment produce new combinations of traits?
hinglish_roman: Independent assortment nayi trait combinations kyun produce karta hai?

original_english: How do Mendel's experiments show that traits are inherited independently?
hinglish_roman: Mendel ke experiments kaise dikhate hain ki traits independently inherit hote hain?

original_english: Can two traits always assort independently? Why or why not?
hinglish_roman: Kya do traits hamesha independently assort hote hain? Kyun ya kyun nahi?

original_english: A gene is a section of DNA that provides information for making one protein.
hinglish_roman: Gene DNA ka woh section hai jo ek protein banane ka information deta hai.

original_english: Different versions of the same gene are called alleles.
hinglish_roman: Ek hi gene ke alag alag versions ko alleles kehte hain.

original_english: When both alleles are identical, the organism is said to be homozygous for that trait.
hinglish_roman: Jab dono alleles identical hote hain toh organism us trait ke liye homozygous hota hai.

original_english: When the two alleles are different, the organism is heterozygous for that trait.
hinglish_roman: Jab dono alleles alag hote hain toh organism us trait ke liye heterozygous hota hai.

original_english: The dominant allele masks the effect of the recessive allele. Recessive traits show only in homozygous recessive organisms.
hinglish_roman: Dominant allele recessive allele ke effect ko mask kar deta hai. Recessive traits sirf homozygous recessive organisms mein dikhte hain.

original_english: Plant height depends on hormone levels, which are controlled by enzymes encoded by genes.
hinglish_roman: Plant ki height hormone levels par depend karti hai jo genes se encoded enzymes control karte hain.

original_english: Each pea plant has two copies of each gene, one inherited from each parent.
hinglish_roman: Har pea plant mein har gene ki do copies hoti hain - ek maternal aur ek paternal.

original_english: What is the difference between a gene and an allele?
hinglish_roman: Gene aur allele mein kya difference hai?

original_english: What is the difference between homozygous and heterozygous organisms?
hinglish_roman: Homozygous aur heterozygous organisms mein kya fark hai?

original_english: When does a recessive trait get expressed?
hinglish_roman: Recessive trait kab express hota hai?

original_english: How do genes control the height of a plant?
hinglish_roman: Genes plant ki height kaise control karte hain?

original_english: In human beings, females have two X chromosomes and males have one X and one Y chromosome.
hinglish_roman: Humans mein females ke paas XX chromosomes hote hain aur males ke paas XY chromosomes hote hain.

original_english: All children inherit an X chromosome from their mother regardless of whether they are boys or girls.
hinglish_roman: Saare bacche apni mother se X chromosome inherit karte hain chahe woh boy ho ya girl.

original_english: The sex of a child is determined by the chromosome inherited from the father.
hinglish_roman: Bacche ki sex uske father se milne wale chromosome par depend karti hai.

original_english: If the father contributes X, the child will be a girl; if Y, the child will be a boy.
hinglish_roman: Agar father X chromosome deta hai toh beti hogi. Agar Y deta hai toh beta hoga.

original_english: Humans have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Humans mein 22 pairs of autosomes hote hain aur ek pair sex chromosomes ka hota hai.

original_english: In some reptiles, sex is determined by temperature at which eggs are kept, not by genetics.
hinglish_roman: Kuch reptiles mein sex genetics se nahi balki eggs jis temperature par rakhe jaate hain usse determine hoti hai. In humans, sex is genetically determined.

original_english: How is the sex of a child determined in human beings?
hinglish_roman: Humans mein bacche ki sex kaise decide hoti hai?

original_english: Why is it wrong to blame the mother for the sex of the child?
hinglish_roman: Bacche ki sex ke liye mother ko blame karna galat kyun hai?

original_english: What is the difference between sex chromosomes and autosomes?
hinglish_roman: Sex chromosomes aur autosomes mein kya difference hai?

original_english: What chromosome does a girl inherit from her father?
hinglish_roman: Beti apne father se kaunsa chromosome inherit karti hai?

original_english: Inherited traits are passed from parents to offspring through genes in the DNA.
hinglish_roman: Inherited traits DNA ke andar genes ke zariye parents se offspring tak pahunchte hain.

original_english: Acquired traits are characteristics developed by an organism during its lifetime due to environmental factors.
hinglish_roman: Acquired traits woh characteristics hain jo ek organism apni life mein environment ki wajah se develop karta hai.

original_english: A body-builder's increased muscle size is an acquired trait. It cannot be inherited by children.
hinglish_roman: Ek body-builder ki muscles ka size ek acquired trait hai. Yeh uske bacche inherit nahi kar sakte.

original_english: Acquired traits are not inherited because they do not cause changes in the DNA of germ cells.
hinglish_roman: Acquired traits inherit nahi hote kyunki woh germ cells ke DNA mein koi change nahi karte.

original_english: What is the difference between an acquired trait and an inherited trait?
hinglish_roman: Acquired trait aur inherited trait mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Can a skill learned during a lifetime be passed to children? Why or why not?
hinglish_roman: Kya ek skill jo ek insaan apni life mein seekhta hai woh uske bachche mein aa sakti hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?

original_english: Why are acquired traits not passed on to the next generation?
hinglish_roman: Acquired traits agli generation mein kyun nahi jaate?

original_english: Give an example of an acquired trait and explain why it cannot be inherited.
hinglish_roman: Ek acquired trait ka example do aur batao ki woh inherit kyun nahi hota.

original_english: When groups of the same species are geographically separated, they may evolve differently over many generations.
hinglish_roman: Jab ek hi species ke groups geographically alag ho jaate hain toh woh kai generations mein alag evolve ho sakte hain.

original_english: New species form when isolated populations accumulate so many differences they can no longer interbreed.
hinglish_roman: Nai species tab banti hai jab isolated populations itni alag ho jaati hain ki woh aapas mein reproduce nahi kar sakti.

original_english: Geographic isolation is an important factor that leads to speciation over time.
hinglish_roman: Geographic isolation speciation mein ek important factor hota hai.

original_english: What is speciation and how does it occur?
hinglish_roman: Speciation kya hai aur yeh kaise hoti hai?

original_english: What role does geographic isolation play in the formation of new species?
hinglish_roman: Geographic isolation new species banane mein kya role play karta hai?

original_english: How do we know if two populations have become separate species?
hinglish_roman: Hum kaise jaante hain ki do populations alag species ban gayi hain?

original_english: Variations that help an organism survive in its environment are more likely to be passed on to the next generation.
hinglish_roman: Jo variations organism ko uske environment mein survive karne mein help karti hain woh agli generation tak zyaada pahunch paati hain.

original_english: Natural selection acts on variations to determine which individuals survive and reproduce.
hinglish_roman: Natural selection variations par act karke decide karta hai ki kaunse individuals survive aur reproduce karenge.

original_english: Sexual reproduction produces more variation than asexual reproduction because genes from two parents combine.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein zyaada variation aati hai kyunki do parents ke genes mix hote hain. Asexual reproduction mein yeh nahi hota.

original_english: How does natural selection lead to evolution?
hinglish_roman: Natural selection evolution ko kaise lead karta hai?

original_english: Why does sexual reproduction produce more variation than asexual reproduction?
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein asexual reproduction se zyaada variation kyun aati hai?

original_english: Each gene set exists not as one long DNA thread, but as separate pieces called chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Har gene set ek lambi DNA thread nahi balki alag alag tukdon ke roop mein hota hai jinhe chromosomes kehte hain.

original_english: Each cell has two copies of each chromosome, one from the male parent and one from the female parent.
hinglish_roman: Har cell mein har chromosome ki do copies hoti hain - ek male parent se aur ek female parent se.

original_english: Every germ cell takes one chromosome from each pair, either from the maternal or paternal set.
hinglish_roman: Har germ cell har chromosome pair se ek chromosome leta hai jo maternal ya paternal origin ka ho sakta hai.

original_english: When two germ cells combine during fertilisation, the normal chromosome number is restored. This ensures genetic stability.
hinglish_roman: Jab do germ cells fertilisation mein combine hote hain toh chromosomes ki normal sankhya restore hoti hai. Isse species ki genetic stability bani rehti hai.

original_english: Both parents contribute equally to the DNA of the progeny during sexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein dono parents progeny ke DNA mein equally contribute karte hain.

original_english: What is the relationship between genes and chromosomes?
hinglish_roman: Genes aur chromosomes mein kya relationship hai?

original_english: Why do germ cells have only one set of chromosomes while body cells have two?
hinglish_roman: Germ cells mein sirf ek set chromosomes kyun hote hain jabki body cells mein do sets hote hain?

original_english: How does fertilisation restore the normal chromosome number in offspring?
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation se offspring mein chromosomes ki normal sankhya kaise restore hoti hai?

original_english: How do chromosomes explain Mendel's law of independent assortment?
hinglish_roman: Chromosomes Mendel ke independent assortment law ko kaise explain karte hain?

original_english: A man with blood group A and a woman with blood group O have a daughter with blood group O. Which trait is dominant?
hinglish_roman: Ek aadmi ka blood group A hai aur uski patni ka O, aur unki beti ka O. Kaunsa trait dominant hai aur kaise pata chala?

original_english: How does the mechanism of chromosomes ensure that both parents contribute equally to the offspring?
hinglish_roman: Chromosomes ka mechanism kaise ensure karta hai ki dono parents offspring mein equally contribute karte hain?

original_english: Why is it important that germ cells have only one set of chromosomes?
hinglish_roman: Yeh kyun zaroori hai ki germ cells mein sirf ek set chromosomes ho?

original_english: Dominant traits are expressed even with one copy of the gene.
hinglish_roman: Dominant trait ek hi copy mein bhi expres ho jata hai.
hinglish_with_error: Dominant trait ek hi copy mein bhi expres ho jata hai.
error_explanation: The word 'expres' is a misspelling of the English word 'express'. In Hinglish, English technical terms like 'express' should retain their correct English spelling.

original_english: Meiosis produces four daughter cells each with half the chromosome number.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis char daughter cells banata hai jinmein se har ek mein aadhe chromosome hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Meiosis char daughter cells banata hai jinmein se har ek mein aadhe kromosome hote hain.
error_explanation: 'Kromosome' is an incorrect phonetic spelling of the scientific term 'chromosome'. Scientific terms must retain their standard English spelling in Hinglish text.

original_english: Mendel conducted experiments using pea plants to study inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne pea plants ka use karke inheritance study ki.
hinglish_with_error: Mendel ne pea plants ka use karke inherritance study ki.
error_explanation: 'Inherritance' has a doubled 'r'. The correct English spelling is 'inheritance'. English loan words in Hinglish must be spelled correctly.

original_english: The sex of the child depends on which chromosome is inherited from the father.
hinglish_roman: Bacche ka sex depend karta hai ki baap se kaun sa chromosome mila.
hinglish_with_error: Bacche ka sex depend karta hai ki baap se kaun sa kromosom mila.
error_explanation: 'Kromosom' is a phonetic Hindi approximation of 'chromosome'. The correct English scientific term 'chromosome' must be used in Hinglish scientific writing.

original_english: Genes control the characteristics of an organism by coding for proteins.
hinglish_roman: Genes organism ki characteristics ko proteins ke liye code karke control karte hain.
hinglish_with_error: Jins organism ki characteristics ko proteins ke liye code karke control karte hain.
error_explanation: 'Jins' is a Hindi word meaning cloth/fabric and is not the correct equivalent of the scientific term 'genes'. The English word 'genes' must be used as it is the accepted technical term in Hinglish science writing.

original_english: What is the difference between dominant and recessive traits?
hinglish_roman: Dominant aur recessive traits mein kya antar hota hai?

original_english: Can you explain the law of independent assortment with an example?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap law of independent assortment ko ek example ke saath explain kar sakte hain?

original_english: How does the sex of a child get determined?
hinglish_roman: Bacche ka sex kaise determine hota hai?

original_english: What is the difference between genotype and phenotype?
hinglish_roman: Genotype aur phenotype mein kya fark hota hai?

original_english: Why does only one quarter of F2 plants show the recessive trait?
hinglish_roman: F2 generation mein sirf ek chaurthai plants hi recessive trait kyun dikhate hain?

original_english: What formula is used to calculate all possible genotype combinations in a cross?
hinglish_roman: Cross mein saare possible genotype combinations calculate karne ke liye kaun sa formula use karte hain?

original_english: Can you give an example of a recessive trait in humans?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap insaanon mein ek recessive trait ka example de sakte hain?

original_english: What is meant by inheritance of traits?
hinglish_roman: Traits ki inheritance se kya matlab hai?

original_english: What is a chromosome and how does it relate to genes?
hinglish_roman: Chromosome kya hota hai aur iska genes se kya sambandh hai?

original_english: How do Mendels experiments prove that traits are inherited independently?
hinglish_roman: Mendel ke experiments kaise prove karte hain ki traits independently inherit hoti hain?

original_english: What is the definition of variation in terms of biology?
hinglish_roman: Biology mein variation ki definition kya hoti hai?

original_english: Compare mitosis and meiosis in terms of their role in heredity.
hinglish_roman: Heredity mein role ke hisaab se mitosis aur meiosis ki comparison karo.

original_english: How can we determine which of two traits is dominant in an organism?
hinglish_roman: Kisi organism mein do traits mein se kaun sa dominant hai yeh kaise pata karein?

original_english: What are alleles and how do they differ from genes?
hinglish_roman: Alleles kya hote hain aur yeh genes se kaise alag hote hain?

original_english: Can you explain what a dihybrid cross is with a Punnett square example?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap dihybrid cross ko Punnett square ke example ke saath explain kar sakte hain?
